reading:
DataBank was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Digital Bridge, now DigitalBridge Group, acquired the company in July 2016 and used it to launch a broader data center investment platform. Trade press reports DigitalBridge later sold a stake in DataBank to Swiss Life Asset Management for approximately $1.2 billion, a transaction this entry records from secondary reporting rather than a confirmed primary source.

DataBank's own company-history page describes growth to more than 65 data centers across more than 27 markets following a series of acquisitions, without stating a precise current total. Among those acquisitions, a January 2022 press release describes DataBank buying Houston-area data centers from CyrusOne, another operator separately tracked in this registry, an example of consolidation moving facilities directly between two operators already profiled here.

The registry here tracks 14 DataBank facilities across six states, California, Nevada, New York, Texas, Utah, and Virginia. As a DigitalBridge-sponsored colocation platform built substantially through acquisition, including at least one purchase directly from CyrusOne, DataBank's history is a useful cross-check for this registry's later facility-level work: any DataBank facility in the Houston, Texas area should be checked against former CyrusOne records for a possible former_operator relationship rather than treated as an independent new build.
